concerns.text: Task T016 (Moving-Window Heuristic) is marked '[X]' (complete) but includes the comment 'FAILED: unspecified'. This creates a semantic contradiction where a task claiming to satisfy FR-004 is simultaneously flagged as failed/unspecified, violating the requirement that deliverables must satisfy their linked FRs.

Task T026b (Symbolic math engine verification) is marked '[ ]' (unchecked) and explicitly noted as 'FAILED: unspecified' in the 'Analyze Report' context. FR-001 and SC-001 require a closed-form derivation verified by a symbolic engine. Without T026b, the theoretical derivation requirement is unfulfilled, constituting a silent relaxation of the spec's core scientific contribution.

Tasks T034d and T034h (Heavy-tailed held-out set validation) are marked '[ ]' (unchecked). FR-012 and US-4 explicitly require generating a held-out set with heavy-tailed noise and verifying the scaling law against it. The absence of these tasks means the 'Validation Independence' principle (Constitution Principle VI) is not implemented, violating the spec's requirement for construct validity.

Tasks T034f (Distribution sensitivity sweep) and T034g (Linear distribution generation) are marked '[ ]' (unchecked). FR-010 requires testing at least three distributions (Linear, Sparse, Non-Convex). The missing tasks for 'Linear' generation and the full sweep logic mean the requirement for 'sensitivity analysis on reward generation distribution' is only partially implemented, violating the spec.

Tasks T036 (Noise correlation MDP extension), T052b (Correlation sweep execution), and T052c (KS-test implementation) are marked '[ ]' (unchecked). FR-009 requires a sensitivity analysis on noise correlation with a KS-test for the slope. The absence of these tasks means the spec's requirement to verify the independence assumption via controlled correlations is not met.

Task T043 (Determine failure point N and verify coincidence) is marked '[ ]' (unchecked). SC-002 explicitly defines the success criterion as the coincidence of the failure point (p < 0.05) with the Pareto distance > 5%. Without T043, the primary success criterion for the project is not implemented, violating the spec.
